name: apply_design_system
description:
Applies a design system to a list of screens. Use this tool when the user wants to update one or more screens to match the style of a design system.
This tool applies the selected design system's foundational design tokens (colors, fonts, shapes, etc.) to the chosen screens, modifying their appearance to align with the design system.

SelectedScreenInstance.description: A screen instance to be edited by the agent, selected by the user.

id.description: Required. The id of the screen instance, **NOT** the source screen id. This is available in the screen instances in the Project info, fetched by `get_project`.

sourceScreen.description: Required. The source screen of the screen instance. The resource name of the source screen. Format: projects/{project}/screens/{screen}

assetId.description: Required. The asset id of the design system to apply, can be fetched from 'list_design_systems'. Example: '15996705518239280238', without the `assets/` prefix.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID of screen instances to edit, example: '4044680601076201931', without the `projects/` prefix.

selectedScreenInstances.description: Required. The screen instances to edit, which is available in the Project info, fetched by `get_project`.
